description.narrative: The activities outlined in the Year 4 Roadmap have been designed to continue developing Gorongosa National Park as an engine for development by strengthening environmental governance, reducing threats to the park’s biodiversity, and improving livelihood opportunities for communities living in the park’s buffer zone. The principal areas of focus for Year 4 include: • Knowledge Management — Supporting the development and implementation of a system designed to capture and disseminate organizational learning throughout the Gorongosa Project. • Staff Support — Providing essential human resources support for an operational, technical and financial oversight when implementing the activities that falls under the 5-Year Business Plan. • Livelihoods – Increasing access to and improving livelihoods, quality of education and health services in the GRP Buffer Zone and expanding small-scale farming, commercial agriculture, employment in agricultural processing factories and eco-tourism;
